Overview

San Miguel de Allende is a city in Guanajuato with a population of 174,615. Colonial masterpiece and expat haven with cobblestone streets, art galleries, and a thriving culinary scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
